newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB shares drop after 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB shares drop after 1996 results.

text.p: Shares in LLoyds TSB Group Plc fell on Friday after the financial services group reported a 52 percent jump in pretax profits for 1996 to 2.51 billion pounds compared with analysts' forecasts of 2.41 to 2.48 billion.
The shares opened 11p weaker at 491 by 0830 GMT.
Traders said that although profits surpassed analysts' expectations they had still disappointed some investors who had hoped for even better results.
"The results were quite exceptional, but that's been discounted by the market for some time now," one said.
Some analysts said that although headline profits exceeded expectations, the figures were rather flattering and the results were not quite as good as the jump in pre-tax profits suggested.
Shares in the group have climbed more than two pounds in recent months, from 300p in June to 502p at Thursday's close, and market-makers said some profit-taking was inevitable after such a run.
"They've shot up since the middle of last year and they have had such a weight of expectation built into them that it's almost impossible to satisfy people's expectations," a market-maker said.
